title: Structure, Analysis, and Synthesis of First-Order Algorithms
summary: First-order optimization algorithms can be interpreted through the lens of dynamical systems as the interconnection of linear systems and a set of subgradient nonlinearities. This dynamical systems formulation allows for the analysis and synthesis of optimization algorithms by solving robust control problems. In this work, we use the celebrated internal model principle in control theory to structurally factorize convergent composite optimization algorithms into suitable internal models and core subcontrollers.
